objectives.en: State the hormones and functions of the thyroid
Explain goitre, cretinism and Graves' disease
Explain how PTH and TCT regulate blood calcium, and the role of the thymus

narration.en: Iodised salt is sold in every shop in Karnataka by law. The reason is a small butterfly-shaped gland in your neck that cannot work without iodine.
narration.kn: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಂಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲೂ ಅಯೋಡೀನ್‌ಯುಕ್ತ ಉಪ್ಪು ಮಾರಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಾರಣ — ಅಯೋಡೀನ್ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಲಾಗದ ಕುತ್ತಿಗೆಯ ಸಣ್ಣ ಚಿಟ್ಟೆಯಾಕಾರದ ಗ್ರಂಥಿ.

body.en: The thyroid gland has two lobes on either side of the trachea, interconnected by a thin flap of connective tissue called the isthmus. It is made of follicles and stromal tissues; each follicle is made of follicular cells enclosing a cavity. The follicular cells synthesise two hormones, tetraiodothyronine or thyroxine (T4) and triiodothyronine (T3). Iodine is essential for their normal rate of synthesis. Iodine deficiency in the diet results in hypothyroidism and enlargement of the thyroid gland, commonly called goitre. Hypothyroidism during pregnancy causes defective development and maturation of the growing baby, leading to stunted growth (cretinism), mental retardation, low intelligence quotient, abnormal skin, deaf-mutism, etc. In adult women it may make the menstrual cycle irregular. Cancer of the thyroid or nodules can cause hyperthyroidism; exophthalmic goitre (Graves' disease) is a form of hyperthyroidism with enlargement of the thyroid, protruding eyeballs, increased basal metabolic rate and weight loss. Thyroid hormones regulate the basal metabolic rate, support RBC formation, control the metabolism of carbohydrates, proteins and fats, and maintain water and electrolyte balance. The thyroid also secretes a protein hormone, thyrocalcitonin (TCT), which regulates blood calcium levels.
body.kn: ಥೈರಾಯ್ಡ್ ಗ್ರಂಥಿಯ ಎರಡು ಹಾಲೆಗಳು ಇಸ್ತ್ಮಸ್‌ನಿಂದ ಜೋಡಣೆಯಾಗಿವೆ. ಅದು T4 (ಥೈರಾಕ್ಸಿನ್) ಮತ್ತು T3 ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಅಯೋಡೀನ್ ಅಗತ್ಯ. ಅಯೋಡೀನ್ ಕೊರತೆಯಿಂದ ಗಳಗಂಡ (ಗಾಯಿಟರ್). ಗರ್ಭಾವಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೈಪೋಥೈರಾಯ್ಡಿಸಮ್‌ನಿಂದ ಕ್ರೆಟಿನಿಸಮ್. ಗ್ರೇವ್ಸ್ ರೋಗ ಹೈಪರ್‌ಥೈರಾಯ್ಡಿಸಮ್‌ನ ಒಂದು ರೂಪ. ಥೈರೋಕ್ಯಾಲ್ಸಿಟೋನಿನ್ ರಕ್ತದ ಕ್ಯಾಲ್ಸಿಯಂ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Iodine deficiency → goitre; hypothyroidism in pregnancy → cretinism

body.en: Humans have four parathyroid glands on the back side of the thyroid, one pair in each of its two lobes. They secrete a peptide hormone, parathyroid hormone (PTH), whose secretion is regulated by the circulating levels of calcium ions. PTH increases the Ca2+ level in blood: it acts on bones and stimulates bone resorption (dissolution or demineralisation), stimulates reabsorption of Ca2+ by the renal tubules and increases Ca2+ absorption from digested food. PTH is therefore a hypercalcemic hormone; together with TCT it plays a significant role in calcium balance. The thymus gland is a lobular structure located between the lungs behind the sternum, on the ventral side of the aorta. It secretes peptide hormones called thymosins, which play a major role in the differentiation of T-lymphocytes (cell-mediated immunity) and promote production of antibodies (humoral immunity). The thymus degenerates in old individuals, decreasing thymosin production, so immune responses of old persons become weak.
body.kn: ಥೈರಾಯ್ಡ್‌ನ ಹಿಂಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಪ್ಯಾರಾಥೈರಾಯ್ಡ್ ಗ್ರಂಥಿಗಳಿವೆ. PTH ರಕ್ತದ ಕ್ಯಾಲ್ಸಿಯಂ ಅನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ — ಇದು ಹೈಪರ್‌ಕ್ಯಾಲ್ಸೆಮಿಕ್ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನು. ಥೈಮಸ್ ಎದೆಮೂಳೆಯ ಹಿಂದೆ ಇದ್ದು ಥೈಮೋಸಿನ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಸ್ರವಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಅವು ಟಿ-ಲಿಂಫೋಸೈಟ್‌ಗಳ ವಿಭೇದನೆಗೆ ಅಗತ್ಯ. ವೃದ್ಧರಲ್ಲಿ ಥೈಮಸ್ ಕ್ಷೀಣಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: PTH: ↑ blood Ca2+ (bone resorption, renal reabsorption, gut absorption)
Thymosins: T-lymphocyte differentiation; thymus shrinks with age

problem.en: A patient's blood calcium is low. Which hormone will rise, and by which three actions will it restore calcium? Which hormone acts in the opposite direction?

steps.en: Low circulating Ca2+ stimulates the parathyroid glands to secrete more PTH.
PTH stimulates bone resorption, increases Ca2+ reabsorption by the renal tubules, and increases Ca2+ absorption from digested food.
Thyrocalcitonin (TCT) from the thyroid regulates blood calcium in the opposite direction, so the two together keep calcium balanced.

answer.en: PTH rises and raises blood calcium through bone, kidney and gut; TCT acts in the opposite direction
